exactQuestion: Why is LMT still routed as unresolved_material_contradiction after immutable Resolver evidence resolved backlog visibility versus cash/program volatility as compatible and non-gating?
whyItMatters: Re-emitting an adjudicated timing/economics tradeoff consumes Resolver capacity and conflates Alpha underwriting risk with contradiction ownership.
lawfulFallbacks: Chief adjudicates deterministic reconciliation consumption without changing methodology or suppressing risk evidence.
Leave LMT Resolver work dormant until routing input changes or Chief explicitly adjudicates.
successCondition: Reconciliation consumes the prior resolved/non-gating LMT disposition, clears unchanged Resolver contradiction ownership, preserves cash-conversion/program-economics volatility, and leaves Alpha underwriting failures intact.

disposition.finding: No new factual contradiction requires adjudication. Strong contracted demand visibility can coexist with volatile realized cash and program economics; fresh routing repeats the already-resolved tradeoff.
disposition.remainingRisk: Multi-period cash conversion, program execution, contract economics and source-addressed numeric underwriting remain material non-gating Council Alpha responsibilities.
disposition.directive: Chief: adjudicate the deterministic reconciliation consumer behavior for LMT. Do not send the unchanged contradiction back to Deep Resolver; preserve timing/execution risks and all Alpha-owned failures.

evidenceBasis.finding: Prior Resolver evidence resolved demand visibility versus cash/program volatility as compatible and explicitly directed deterministic reconciliation to consume the disposition.
Fresh routing still places LMT in Resolver for unresolved_material_contradiction despite that disposition.

antiRepeat.repeatedBlocker: Deterministic reconciliation did not consume the prior immutable LMT resolved/non-gating disposition.
antiRepeat.failedStrategy: Prior contradiction adjudication plus explicit reconciliation directive did not clear Resolver routing.
antiRepeat.changedStrategy: Do not re-adjudicate or reacquire evidence. Escalate the exact consumer decision to Chief and leave LMT dormant until routing/input signature changes.

learning.newLesson: When a prior Resolver disposition explicitly directs reconciliation and the same contradiction returns unchanged, the second cycle is a Chief-owned consumer exception.
